2021.title: HAPI Struct <> Proto Conversion Tool
2021.short_description: HAPI resources are like conventional data classes that can be serialized into JSON/XML. FHIR proto buffs on the other hand are classes that are used...
2021.description:
HAPI resources are like conventional data classes that can be serialized into JSON/XML. FHIR proto buffs on the other hand are classes that are used to create the protocol buffers for the FHIR resource they represent.

This project is aimed at creating a library that will convert HAPI structs (which use JSON or XML data) to FHIR protos which use Protocol Buffers. This would enhance healthcare data exchange due to the better performance of protocol buffers. It would also allow HAPI commands to run on data stored in FHIR protos. Sample code that would demonstrate the use of this library to execute Clinical Quality Language Using HAPI against FHIR protos will also be included.

2021.title: Implementation of FHIRPath for FHIRProto in a Java library
2021.short_description: Create a Java library that implements the FHIRPath graph traversal language (with a FHIRPath Engine) for use with Google's serialization format...
2021.description: Create a Java library that implements the FHIRPath graph traversal language (with a FHIRPath Engine) for use with Google's serialization format protocol buffers and write documentation that explains how this library can be used. FHIRPath allows for extraction of information and traversal of all types of FHIR resources. This is important for healthcare interoperability, as it is necessary to have fast navigation, selection and formulation of invariants in both Fast Healthcare Interoperability resources and HL7 Clinical Query language. As proto binaries take up less space, this will put less strain on community medical teams and facilities in low-income countries.
